reason: I get everyday abayas on Shein or TikTok Shop for $20 to $30 and just wait for sales, so $45 for an everyday one and $75 to $80 for a thobe is a lot for me, even with 15% off for one day. Driving out to Westchase on a Sunday after a work week in the Medical Center for a deal I can mostly beat online isn't worth it right now.
objection: Is the fabric actually nicer than the cheap stuff I already buy, or am I paying double for the same thin, see-through crepe with a boutique tag on it?
would_change_my_mind: A real sale I can't get online, like everyday abayas around $30 or a buy-two deal, plus seeing in person that the fabric is thick and not scratchy. I'd maybe go closer to Eid or a wedding when I need something nicer anyway.
